title: Feature film production
goal: Show a film schedule from greenlight through festival delivery with coordinated production and post-production dependencies.

rubric.must: Principal photography visibly waits for both cast leads and built sets.
Final colour grade visibly waits for both sound mix and visual effects before festival delivery.
A visible chain runs from Greenlight through screenplay, casting or locations, and principal photography.
Sound design and visual effects visibly branch in parallel after picture edit.
Greenlight and Festival Delivery are visibly distinguished as milestones.
The longest dependency chain is visibly highlighted as the critical path.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all six rules, while the picture fails both blockers and omits critical-path highlighting.
